arithmetic.floating_point_role: Only proposes each rational witness and selects which already-positive lower margin to summarize.

claim: The explicit three-exponential inequality (16) holds strictly throughout the closed gap-coordinate square 1<=z,w<=4.
conclusion: All leafwise Arb positivity checks passed; no unresolved box remains inside 1<=z,w<=4.
implication: At alpha<=4*exp(-3), the three-exponential quantile Hessian is positive semidefinite at every coefficient vector whose normalized gap coordinates lie in this square.
limitation: This closes a compact interior square only. It does not prove three-exponential convexity on the remaining off-symmetry domain or imply a general-n Stringer theorem.

partition.coverage: closed square, with shared box boundaries

proof_interface: Each leaf has a rational x with x*K-L positive definite and S_(z,w)(x)>4*exp(-3). Therefore h(z,w)<x and monotonicity gives S_(z,w)(h)>4*exp(-3).
